名称(中英文): Australian Carbon Credit Unit (ACCU) Scheme/澳大利亚碳信用单位 （ACCU） 计划

工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
澳大利亚政府
2011年成立减排基金（ERF），该基金为澳大利亚碳信用项目库提供支撑，规定37种活动可以生成碳信用单位。碳信用单位可以出售给政府或通过二级
市场出售，目前价格为75澳元/吨。2021年澳洲政府将CCUS纳入减排基
金，符合条件的CCUS项目减排量在核证后可获得碳
信用单位。
主要内容(原文):
Under the ACCU Scheme, participants run projects that reduce or avoid greenhouse emissions (emissions avoidance) or remove and store carbon from the atmosphere (sequestration). Participants can earn one ACCU for every tonne of carbon dioxide equivalent (t CO₂-e) emissions their project stores or avoids.Participants can sell ACCUs on the secondary market or to the Australian Government by entering a carbon abatement contract.
On the secondary market, private buyers purchase ACCUs to voluntarily offset their emissions or meet compliance requirements.
Buyers also include Australia's highest emitting facilities under the Safeguard Mechanism. They're required to keep emissions below set baselines and can do this by buying and surrendering ACCUs. Safeguard facilities can also earn ACCUs by running their own projects.

主要内容:
加拿大将把电力、石油和天然气等作为减排的主要目标行业。该计划把当前的碳定价机制作为基石，到2030年，碳价将从目前每吨50加元的水平上涨至170加元，以推动消费者使用更清洁的能源。另外，加拿大政府将投资91亿加元用于新能源产业，包括增加对零排放汽车的鼓励措施，为采用碳捕获、利用和储存技术的化石燃料行业提供更优惠的税收政策，并努力使加拿大的电网更清洁。(1)最终确定现有政策措施。加拿大政府应完成已宣布或部分制定的温室气体减排政策，包括：清洁经济投资税收抵免；石油和天然气行业排放上限；《清洁电力法规》；《加拿大绿色建筑战略》；垃圾填埋甲烷法规；中重型零排放汽车销售标准；2026年后轻型和重型车辆温室气体排放标准。
(2)解决政策之间的负面互动。政府应积极解决联邦气候政策与基于产出的定价体系之间的负面相互作用。解决这些负面相互作用可以带来石油和天然气、电力和重工业的额外减排，并进一步缩小2030年的排放差距。
(3)加强工业碳定价。加拿大政府应采取行动加强工业碳定价，措施包括：确认2026年对基于产出的定价体系的评估成为系统、透明和规范化流程的一部分；在2024年底前，就收紧基于产出的定价体系的方案进行磋商；2026年联邦对省和地区大型排放交易系统的评估基于与2030年减排目标的兼容性；尽快实施基础广泛的碳差价合约计划，以便在2030年之前实现减排，并消除对政策不确定性的担忧。
(4)确保石油和天然气行业进一步减排。收紧石油和天然气排放上限：加强所有部门基于产出的定价体系绩效标准并扩大碳差价合约计划。
(5)评估并采取进一步行动。为了解决2030年剩余的排放缺口，加拿大政府应采取以下政策：加强油气甲烷减排80%的监管；最终确定和公开说明2030年后碳价时间表，确保其经过通胀调整；推行低排放运输鼓励政策；最迟2030年开始，逐步减少住宅和商业建筑中化石燃料供暖和制冷设备的销售；设定新建商业建筑的性能标准。

主要内容(原文): As the Canadian government has announced the phase-out of unabated coal generation by 2030, the CCUS-equipped Unit 3 of the Boundary Dam plant will be allowed to remain open as it complies with regulatory requirements. The power plant produces 115 MW of clean base load electricity, enough to power 100 000 homes, and is now expected to be in service for an additional three decades. The technologies applied will allow the project to reduce SO2 emissions by up to 100% and CO2 by up to 90%. The power plant has captured over 4 Mt CO2, with most of it used in enhanced oil recovery and stored, and a smaller portion injected and stored in Aquistore, a deep geological CO2 storage research site. The lessons learned from Boundary Dam also provide a foundation for capturing CO2 in a variety of sectors where CCUS deployment will be critical – including in cement, iron and steel, and natural gas power generation.

主要内容: 排放企业需按照规定的基于产出的绩效标准来减少其温室气体排放。这项立法适用于每年二氧化碳当量（CO2e）排放量超过 1 万吨的电力设施，以及每年二氧化碳当量排放量超过 2.5 万吨的工业设施。受监管的排放企业必须为其拥有或运营的每个设施确定一个基准排放水平，并按照《温室气体管理与减排（报告）标准》中规定的标准提交年度报告。如果在一个合规年度内，受监管的排放总量超过了允许排放量，排放企业就产生了合规义务。合规义务可通过以下一种或多种方式来履行：向萨斯喀彻温省政府付款、注销绩效积分、注销碳CCUS积分，或者采用经部长批准的、符合该法案温室气体减排目标的替代合规方案。萨斯喀彻温省二氧化碳当量累计排放上限，在 2020 年至 2024 年的合规期内，这一上限为 7700 万吨；而在 2025 年至 2029 年的合规期内，上限为 6450 万吨。该法案设立了萨斯喀彻温省技术基金，用于支持那些有助于减少、封存或捕获温室气体的省级项目。
主要内容(原文): The legislation applies to electricity facilities emitting more than 10,000 tonnes CO2e per year and industrial facilities emitting more than 25,000 tonnes CO2e per year. If total regulated emissions exceed permitted emissions during a compliance year, the emitter incurs a compliance obligation. Compliance obligations may be fulfilled through one or more of the following actions: payment to the Government of Saskatchewan, retirement of performance credits, retirement of CCUS credits or an alternative compliance option approved by the minister that is consistent with the GHG emission reduction objective of the Act. Part 4 of the General and Electricity Producer Regulations under the Act establishes a CO2e Cumulative Emissions Cap for All Facilities in Saskatchewan for designated compliance periods. The cap is 77,000,000 tonnes for the compliance period 2020-2024 and 64,500,000 tonnes for compliance period 2025-2029. Finally, the Act establishes the Saskatchewan Technology Fund to support provincial initiatives that lead to mitigation, sequestration or capture of GHGs.

主要内容(原文): Member States should determine in which cases explora­ tion is required to generate the information necessary for the site selection. Exploration, that is activities intruding into the subsurface, should be made subject to a permit requirement. Member States do not need to set admission criteria for procedures for granting exploration permits, but where they do, they should at least ensure that the pro­ cedures for the granting of exploration permits are open to all entities possessing the necessary capacities. Member States should also ensure that the permits are granted on the basis of objective, published and non-discriminatory criteria. In order to protect and encourage exploration investments, exploration permits should be granted for a limited volume area and for a limited time during which the holder of the permit should have the sole right to explore the potentialCO2 storage complex. Member States should ensure that no conflicting uses of the complex are permitted during this time. If no activities are carried out within a reasonable time, Member States should ensure that the exploration permit is withdrawn and can be granted to other entities.

The greenhouse gas emissions of the production of fossil-based hydrogen with carbon capture or pyrolysis are lower than for fossil-fuel based hydrogen, but the variable effectiveness of greenhouse gas capture (maximum 90%) needs to be taken into account. ‘Low-carbon hydrogen’ encompasses fossil-based hydrogen with carbon capture and electricity-based hydrogen, with significantly reduced full life-cycle greenhouse gas emissions compared to existing hydrogen production

主要内容(原文): The United States’Carbon Storage Assurance Facility Enterprise (CarbonSAFE) Initiative is aimed at developing CO2 storage projects, with a goal to ensure the projects will be ready for CCUS deployment by 2025-2030. More specifically, the CarbonSAFE Initiative aims to “address the R & D knowledge gaps and develop the technologies needed to nationally deploy commercial scale (50+ million metric tons) CO2 storage; understand the development of a CCUS storage complex from the feasibility study through the point of injection; improve understanding of commercial-scale project screening, site selection, geologic characterization, modelling, and monitoring; and address both the technical and non-technical challenges associated with characterization, permitting, and monitoring of a geologic storage complex.” The US Department of Energy and National Energy Technology Laboratory are responsible for the CarbonSAFE Initiative. It was started in 2016, and as of 2019, 19 projects have been funded.

主要内容: 为促进碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）技术的发展，艾伯塔省正通过一个竞争性程序来赋予碳封存权，从而推动碳存储枢纽的开发。一个碳封存枢纽将是一个孔隙空间区域，比如岩层，由一家公司进行监管，该公司能够有效地规划并为工业客户提供从各种排放源捕获的二氧化碳的碳封存服务。2022 年，阿尔伯塔省选择了 6 个提案，开始探索如何在该地区安全地开发碳储存中心。之后发起了第二轮竞赛，为第一轮未涵盖的全省其他地区提供碳封存服务。阿尔伯塔省选择了 19 个提案，开始探索如何安全地开发碳储存中心。
主要内容(原文):
To facilitate the growth of CCUS technologies, Alberta is enabling carbon sequestration rights through a competitive process that enables the development of carbon storage hubs. A carbon sequestration hub will be an area of pore space, such as rock formations, overseen by a company who can effectively plan and enable carbon sequestration of captured carbon dioxide from various emissions sources as a service to industrial clients.
In 2022, Alberta selected 6 proposals to begin exploring how to safely develop carbon storage hubs in the region. A second competition was launched to provide carbon storage services to regions across the rest of the province not covered by the first round. Alberta selected 19 proposals to begin exploring how to safely develop carbon storage hubs.

艾伯塔省碳干线于 2020 年开始运营，从一家化肥厂和炼油厂捕获二氧化碳。该项目从艾伯塔省政府获得了 1.64 亿美元的资金，从加拿大政府获得了4600 万美元的资金。

The Government of Canada, as well as provincial governments in Alberta and Saskatchewan have provided grant funding for major operating CCUS projects.

The Shell Quest Carbon Capture and Storage Project, which equipped the hydrogen production unit at a major refinery with CCUS, received CAD 745 (USD 572 million) from the Government of Alberta and CAD 120 million from the Government of Canada (USD 92 million).
The Alberta Carbon Trunk Line, which began operating in 2020 with CO2 capture from a fertiliser plant and refinery, received CAD 223 (USD 164 million) from the Government of Alberta and CAD 63 million from the Government of Canada (USD 46 million).

主要内容:
该计划是一项综合性举措，旨在减少上游石油和天然气行业中因放空和燃烧活动而产生的温室气体（GHG）排放。它将基于成果的灵活监管措施与 10 项新的配套政策和计划相结合，以保护产业竞争力并降低碳泄漏风险。此外，该计划设定了到 2025 年每年减少 450 万吨二氧化碳当量（CO₂e）的甲烷排放这一目标。
在所列的配套政策中包括：伴生气保护计划，旨在为上游石油和天然气行业创造更多机会，使甲烷能够在石油生产设施之间进行销售和输送，以实现现场使用；萨斯喀彻温省石油创新激励政策，将为那些具备更好管理温室气体排放能力的商业创新项目提供特许权使用费抵免；以及油气加工投资激励政策，将为所有大规模的增值油气设施提供特许权使用费抵免，这些设施包括甲烷收集、加工和发电基础设施，以及碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）项目。
主要内容(原文):
The plan is a comprehensive approach to reducing GHG emissions from venting and flaring activities in the upstream oil and gas industry. It combines flexible results-based regulations with 10 new complementary policies and programs to protect industrial competitiveness and limit carbon leakage risks. Furthermore, it sets the target of reducing methane emissions by 4.5 million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) annually by 2025.
Among the listed complementary policies are the: Associated Gas Conservation Program, aiming to create more opportunities in the upstream oil and gas industry for the sale and movement of methane between oil production facilities for the purpose of on-site use; the Saskatchewan Petroleum Innovation Incentive that will provide a royalty credit for commercial innovation projects with the ability to better manage GHG emissions; and the Oil and Gas Processing Investment Incentive, which will provide a royalty credit for all large-scale value-added oil and gas facilities, including methane gathering, processing and power generation infrastructure, and carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) projects.

能源绩效包括：

能源效率 – 使用更少的能源来做同样的事情。
需求灵活性 – 改变能源的使用时间和方式。
电气化或燃料转换 – 改用电力驱动技术或其他更清洁的能源。
该战略提供了一个管理能源需求的长期框架，因此我们的社区可以享受提高能源绩效带来的经济、气候和健康效益。该框架还将有助于澳大利亚实现我们立法的减排和可再生能源目标。
主要内容(原文):
The National Energy Performance Strategy will coordinate action to improve energy performance for all Australians.

Energy performance includes:

Energy efficiency – using less energy to do that same thing.
Demand flexibility – varying when and how energy is used.
Electrification or fuel switching – swapping to electricity powered technologies or other cleaner sources of energy.
The strategy provides a long-term framework to manage energy demand, so our community can enjoy the economic, climate and health benefits of improved energy performance. The framework will also contribute to Australia meeting our legislated emissions reduction and renewable energy targets.

2021 年 6 月 30 日，丹麦政府与议会各党派就二氧化碳封存路线图（CCS 战略的第一部分）达成一致。该协议包括一系列短期和长期在丹麦地下封存二氧化碳的措施。
具体而言，该协议启动了北海丹麦部分地区二氧化碳封存许可的准备工作，以便最早于2025年在枯竭的油气田进行封存。该协议还实现了二氧化碳的跨国进出口和运输。
此外，该协议还拨款 2.1 亿丹麦克朗，用于研究丹麦底土中所有相关和潜在的封存可能性，相关市政当局和公民等也将密切参与其中。
主要内容(原文):
On 30 June 2021, the Government and a broad range of parliamentary parties agreed on A roadmap for CO2 storage – first part of a CCS strategy. The agreement consists of a number of initiatives enabling storage in the Danish subsoil in both the short and long terms.
Specifically, the agreement started the process of preparing for the granting of licenses for CO2 storage in the Danish part of the North Sea, so that storage in depleted oil and gas fields could take place as early as 2025. The agreement also enables the import, export and transport of CO2 across national borders.
Furthermore, the agreement has allocated funding of DKK 210 million for studies of all relevant and potential storage possibilities in the Danish subsoil with close involvement of relevant municipalities, citizens, etc.

2022 年 6 月 21 日，丹麦政府与广泛的政治多数派就丹麦二氧化碳封存监管框架--丹麦二氧化碳捕集与封存战略的后续行动--达成协议。
在该协议中，丹麦政府决定成为丹麦二氧化碳封存许可证的共同所有者。丹麦的底土是一种共享资源，国家的参与将确保国家能够对与 CCS 相关的底土活动产生影响。国家的参与还将确保丹麦社会能够分享二氧化碳封存可能带来的经济收益。
协议各方还决定，所有权将由 Nordsøfonden 公司承担，因为该公司在参与石油和天然气活动方面拥有必要的经验和能力，可以保护国家利益。
主要内容(原文):
On 21 June 2022, the Government and a broad political majority reached an agreement on Regulatory framework for CO2 storage in Denmark – Follow-up on Denmark's CCS strategy.
In this agreement, a decision was taken ensure that the Danish state will be a co-owner of CO2 storage licenses in Denmark. The Danish subsoil is a shared resource, and state participation ensures that the state can have influence on subsoil activities related to CCS. State participation will also ensure that Danish society gets a share in any potential economic gains from CO2 storage.
The parties to the agreement furthermore decided that state ownership will be assumed by Nordsøfonden, which is deemed to have the necessary experience and competence from its engagement in oil and gas activities to protect the state's interests.

主要内容: 《能源改进与扩展法案》（2008年）制定了《国内税收法》第45Q条，为碳捕获和封存提供税收抵免。这一规定旨在通过为捕获和储存二氧化碳的企业提供财政激励，鼓励私营部门对CCUS技术的投资。税收抵免适用于从工业源捕获二氧化碳并将其永久地下储存或以防止其释放到大气中的方式利用（如提高石油采收率或生产其他产品）的设施。最初的45Q税收抵免相对较少，每公吨储存的二氧化碳提供高达50美元，但它为未来支持CCUS发展的扩展和改进奠定了基础
主要内容(原文): The Energy Improvement and Extension Act of 2008 established Section 45Q of the Internal Revenue Code, which provides tax credits for carbon capture and sequestration. This provision was designed to encourage private investment in CCUS technologies by offering financial incentives to businesses that capture and store carbon dioxide. The tax credit applies to facilities that capture CO2 from industrial sources and either permanently store it underground or utilize it in ways that prevent its release into the atmosphere, such as enhanced oil recovery or the production of other products. The original 45Q tax credit was relatively modest, providing up to $50 per metric ton of CO2 stored, but it laid the groundwork for future expansions and improvements to support CCUS development
关键词: 税收抵免，碳捕集，碳封存
关键词(英文): Tax credits, carbon capture, carbon sequestration

名称(中英文): BIPARTISAN BUDGET ACT OF 2018/2018 年加强两党预算法案
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 2018年《两党预算法案》修订了《国内税收法》第45Q条，大幅扩大了碳捕获和封存税收抵免的价值、持续时间和资格。修订后的45Q税收抵免提高了每吨二氧化碳的抵免金额，采用了递进式的二氧化碳补贴价格结构。例如，通过地质封存储存二氧化碳的税收抵免提高到每公吨最高50美元，而用于提高石油采收率（EOR）或其他利用方法的二氧化碳，税收抵免提高到每公吨最高35美元。该法案还延长了税收抵免的持续时间，并扩大了资格标准，为鼓励企业投资CCUS技术提供了更大的激励
主要内容(原文): The Bipartisan Budget Act of 2018 amended Section 45Q of the Internal Revenue Code, significantly expanding the value, duration, and eligibility of the carbon capture and sequestration tax credits. The revised 45Q tax credit increased the per-ton CO2 credit amounts, with a progressive CO2 subsidy price structure. For example, the tax credit for CO2 stored through geological sequestration was raised to up to $50 per metric ton, while for CO2 used in enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or other utilization methods, the credit was increased to up to $35 per metric ton. The act also extended the duration of the tax credit and broadened eligibility criteria, providing greater incentive for businesses to invest in CCUS technologies
关键词: 税收抵免，碳捕集，碳封存，地质利用
关键词(英文): Tax credits, carbon capture, carbon storage, geological utilization

名称(中英文): California: Fuels: Low Carbon Fuel Standard/加州政府的低碳燃料标准
CCUS环节: 运输,捕集,封存,利用（包括地质利用）
工具类型: 财政激励（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 加州的低碳燃料标准（LCFS）计划为降低产品碳强度的燃料生产商提供积分，包括使用CCUS和CCS生产的燃料。州总量控制与交易计划还允许实体使用通过矿井甲烷捕获协议生成的碳抵消积分，以符合州的温室气体减排目标。此外，加州保护与土地资源部的地质能源管理处（CalGEM），负责监督州内的石油、天然气和地热资源，通过财政援助直接支持在州内运营的CCUS和CCS项目
主要内容(原文): California’s Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) program provides credits to fuel producers that reduce the carbon intensity of their products, including those produced using CCUS and CCS. The state cap-and-trade program also allows entities to use carbon offset credits, generated through the Mine Methane Capture protocol, to comply with the state’s greenhouse gas reduction goals. Additionally, the California Department of Conservation’s Geologic Energy Management Division (CalGEM), which oversees oil, gas, and geothermal resources in the state, directly supports CCUS and CCS projects operating within the state through financial assistance
关键词: 碳交易信用，资金支持
关键词(英文): Carbon trading credits, financial support

名称(中英文): Energy Act of 2020 (CCUS provisions)/2020能源法案
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 《2020能源法案》授权在五年内为各种碳管理和移除项目提供近70亿美元的资金，包括重新授权美国能源部（DOE）的化石能源研究与开发项目。法案包括为关键行业（如重工业）的碳捕获技术进行大规模试点项目和商业规模示范的规定，开发大规模储存项目，建立包括直接空气捕获技术竞赛的碳移除项目，以及碳利用项目。该法案还改革了能源部的贷款计划，利用现有资源为额外的技术创新和部署提供资金。此外，法案还将CCUS项目的45Q税收抵免延长两年，允许在2026年前开始建设的项目获得税收抵免
主要内容(原文): The Energy Act of 2020 authorizes nearly $7 billion for various carbon management and removal programs over five years, including reauthorization of Fossil Energy Research and Development Programs at the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE). It includes provisions for large-scale pilot projects and commercial-scale demonstrations of carbon-capture technologies in key sectors such as heavy industry, development of large-scale storage projects, establishment of a carbon removal program including a direct air capture technology prize competition, and a carbon utilization program. The Act also reforms the DOE's Loan Program to finance additional technology innovation and deployment with existing resources. Additionally, it extends the 45Q tax credits for CCUS projects by two years, allowing those that begin construction before 2026 to receive a credit

名称(中英文): AMERICAN RECOVERY AND REINVESTMENT ACT OF 2009/美国复苏与再投资法案（ARRA）

工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 《美国复苏与再投资法案》（2009年）为碳捕获与储存（CCS）项目提供了34亿美元的资金。其中约26亿美元分配给了九个大型示范项目，其中五个针对燃煤电厂，四个针对各种工业应用。最大的项目FutureGen获得了约10亿美元，用于展示二氧化碳的捕获、运输和储存。此外，6亿美元被分配给52个较小的项目，以推动工业领域的CCS发展，剩余的资金则用于诸如二氧化碳储存的地质选址调查等活动
主要内容(原文): The American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 provided $3.4 billion for carbon capture and storage (CCS) programs. Approximately $2.6 billion of this funding was allocated to nine large demonstration projects, with five focused on coal-fired power plants and four on various industrial applications. The largest project, FutureGen, received about $1 billion to demonstrate CO2 capture, transport, and storage. Additionally, $0.6 billion was allocated to 52 smaller projects to advance CCS in industry, and remaining funds went to activities like geological site surveys for CO2 storage

名称(中英文): Climate Action Plan 2021-2030 /（2021-2030年气候行动计划）
CCUS环节: 集群
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
挪威的 2021-2030 年气候行动计划制定了到 2030 年实现 50-55% 减排的总体计划，但没有明确提及 CDR。该计划还提到了挪威政府与国家农业组织之间达成的一项自愿协议，该协议承诺在 2021-2030 年期间将农业部门的温室气体排放量减少 500 万吨。
挪威环境署是气候与环境部下属的政府机构，最近为 CDR 提出了创新激励措施。建议包括实施反向 CO2税，并撤销为每吨 CO 提供金钱奖励。此外，他们还建议将国家 CDR 政策与在自愿碳市场交易 CDR 信用的选项相结合。该机构随后的报告估计每年可能贡献 1 MtCO2通过 DACCS（直接空气碳捕获和储存）和 1 Mt + 0.5 Mt 生物 CCS，包括 BECCS，到 2030 年减少 55%。
挪威的林业部门历来在土地利用、土地利用变化和基于林业 （LULUCF） 的搬迁中发挥着重要作用。它是挪威主要的温室气体汇。《2021-2030 年气候行动计划》第 4 章对林业在基于 LULUCF 的清除中的作用提出了类似的观点，并提供了关于 LULUCF 行业的专门报告。
主要内容(原文): The Ministry of Finance presented updated emission projections for Norway in the 2021 National budget. These are described further in Chapter 3.2. There is considerable uncertainty relating to the estimated effects of current climate policy on emissions in the future. The projections indicate that Norway is likely to stay within its emission budget for the first few years of the period 2021–2030, but that further policy developments will be needed to close the emissions gap later on. The emissions gap is even larger for the 45 % reduction target. In other words, it will be necessary to make Norway’s current climate policy more ambitious, both to meet the commitment in the agreement with the EU and to achieve the Government’s target of reducing non-ETS emissions by 45 % through domestic measures.

名称(中英文): Longship/（长船计划）
CCUS环节: 运输,捕集,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 标准体系（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
“长船”碳捕集与封存（CCS）项目于2020年启动，是挪威主要的CCS示范项目，预算约为24亿欧元，其中约三分之二的资金来自公共资金。该项目由三部分组成：
“北极光”项目
“北极光”项目负责将二氧化碳从挪威海岸运输到海底地质封存地点。该项目由Equinor、壳牌（Shell）和道达尔（Total）合作开发。在第一阶段，预计在25年的运营期内每年封存150万吨二氧化碳。这部分封存容量将用于以下两个“长船”项目，剩余容量将向来自国外的二氧化碳开放。2022年8月，与荷兰公司雅苒（Yara）签署了第一份意向书，计划从2025年起每年封存80万吨二氧化碳。2023年5月，与丹麦Ørsted公司签署了运输和服务协议，计划每年封存43万吨生物源二氧化碳。
布雷维克水泥厂碳捕集设施
将在布雷维克的一家水泥厂增设碳捕集设施。该工厂约10%的二氧化碳排放来自生物源。捕集的二氧化碳将通过船舶运输至“北极光”封存地点。该设施预计于2024年投入运营。
哈弗斯隆奥斯陆Celsio项目
Hafslund Oslo Celsio计划从挪威最大的垃圾焚烧设施中每年捕集40万吨二氧化碳。由于大约一半的垃圾来自生物源，该项目可能产生负排放。捕集的二氧化碳也将通过船舶运输至“北极光”设施。然而，由于成本超出预期，该项目已于2023年4月暂停。
主要内容(原文):
Northern Lights is developing the world’s first open-source CO2 transport and storage infrastructure. We deliver carbon storage as a service. Our aim is to help industrial emitters stop emissions that cannot be avoided in other ways from reaching the atmosphere and to provide a safe and permanent storage option for CO2 that is removed from the air.

We are part of a growing movement to actively manage the carbon cycle and get it back in balance. As we develop our business, we will share, listen and encourage innovation and technology development.

Northern Lights is a first – and we want to make it easy for others to follow.

名称(中英文): Carbon pollution pricing systems across Canada/加拿大的碳污染定价制度
CCUS环节: 捕集,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 标准体系（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 自 2019 年以来，加拿大碳污染定价方法确保全国范围内的碳定价严格程度相似，同时保持各省和地区的灵活性。各省和地区可以根据自己的需求设计自己的定价系统，只要该系统符合联邦最低国家严格标准（也称为联邦“基准”）。如果某个省或地区决定不对污染定价，或提议的制度不符合这些标准，则将采用联邦制度。联邦支持制度包括两部分：一、对汽油和天然气等化石燃料征收的监管费，称为燃料费。二、以绩效为基础的行业定价体系，即产出型定价体系 。在一个司法管辖区内，可以适用其中一个部分，或者两个部分都适用。
主要内容(原文):
Since 2019, the Pan Canadian Approach to Pricing Carbon Pollution has ensured carbon pricing is in place at similar levels of stringency across the country while maintaining flexibility for provinces and territories. Provinces and territories can design their own pricing system tailored to their needs as long as it meets federal minimum national stringency standards, also known as the federal ‘benchmark’.If a province or territory decides not to price pollution, or proposes a system that does not meet these standards, the federal system is put in place. The federal backstop has two parts:
a regulatory charge on fossil fuels like gasoline and natural gas, known as the fuel charge
a performance-based system for industries, known as the Output-Based Pricing System 
One or both parts can apply in a jurisdiction.
关键词: 碳污染定价，燃料费，产出型定价系统
关键词(英文): Carbon pollution pricing，Fuel charge，Output-Based Pricing System

工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
P2X（以电能为动力，将二氧化碳和氢气转化为合成碳氢化合物等能源产品）合成碳氢化合物是全球能源系统中实现化石二氧化碳净零排放的重要元素。CCU和 P2X正处于紧张的研发阶段，该领域在芬兰也在稳步发展。高价值的 CCU 应用（包括特种化学品和聚合物）更有可能率先商业化。VTT（芬兰国家技术研究中心）正在开发一种BECCU工艺，其中100% 的多元醇碳来自二氧化碳和氢气。此外，通过使用二氧化碳作为原材料，可以用绿色电力生产高价值的碳基材料，如纳米管和石墨烯，拉彭兰塔大学LUT正在研究这一点。
此外，关于清洁氢气生产的方法，使用可再生能源发电通过水电解制氢是最可持续的选择。所有其他主要基于化石燃料利用的制氢方法都需要有效的CCU/CCS添加才能实现部分碳中和。因此，在考虑绿色氢生产和与之相关的商业潜力时，需要在氢价值链的一般层面上增加可再生发电和配电。
主要内容(原文):
Synthetic hydrocarbons by P2X are an essential element in the global energy system to achieve net-zero fossil carbon dioxide emissions. CCU and P2X are under an intense RD&D phase, and the field is steadily growing also in Finland. Higher value CCU applications including specialty chemicals and polymers have higher potential to commercialise first. VTT is developing a BECCU-process where 100 % of polyol carbon is originating from carbon dioxide and sustainable hydrogen. In addition, high value carbon-based materials, such as nanotubes and graphene, could be produced with green electricity by using CO2 as a raw material, which is being studied at Lappeenranta University LUT.
Furthermore, regarding methods for clean hydrogen production, hydrogen made with water electrolysis using electricity made with renewables is the most sustainable option. All other hydrogen production methods, mainly based on utilisation of fossil fuels, would need effective CCU/CCS addition to achieve even partial carbon-neutrality. Therefore, renewable electricity generation and distribution needs to be added in the general level of the hydrogen value chain, when considering green hydrogen production and business potential connected to that.
关键词: CCS、CCU、低碳氢气
关键词(英文): CCS、CCU、low-carbon hydrogen

In its autumn budget session in 2021, Sanna Marin’s Government defined that a “national hydrogen strategy, including the P2X technology, hydrogen production and the advancement of CCSU solutions” will be prepared as part of the climate and energy strategy under preparation. According to the records of the budget session, a Government resolution will be prepared based on the strategy to promote the hydrogen economy.
Promoting the development of the EU’s CCS/CCU regulatory framework. 
Accelerating the development and deployment of technologies and solutions for the recovery, storage and use of carbon dioxide (CCS/CCU) by funding piloting and demonstration projects.

名称(中英文): Summary of Sectoral Low-Carbon Roadmaps 2024/    2024年行业低碳路线图摘要
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
支持项目类型: 单一环节项目,多环节项目
主要内容:
路线图强调了碳捕集、封存和利用（CCUS）在实现减排中的核心作用。例如，在能源行业的低碳方案中，预计到 2050 年可回收约 100 万吨碳。森林产业的方案估计，到 2040 年，每年可捕集多达 600 万生物碳，其中 5万吨 CO2/a 可用作工业原料。化工行业的低碳方案预计 2030 年后每年可回收 0.5 百万吨 CO2，其中生物碳占 0.2 百万吨 CO2。
路线图建议修改立法，以支持新的 CCU 产品进入市场。例如，能源行业的路线图建议，可持续生物能源和废物产生的二氧化碳应被接受为生产合成燃料的原料。投资补贴、税收减免和激励措施也应被用来促进二氧化碳捕集与封存（CCS&U）。森林工业的路线图呼吁为示范和试点工厂以及随后的商业工厂建立激励制度。路线图强调了项目顺利审批的必要性，生物能源行业的路线图指出了双边协议在促进捕集的二氧化碳封存方面的潜在重要性，因为芬兰缺乏合适的二氧化碳封存地质构造。
主要内容(原文):
Several roadmaps highlight the central role of carbon capture, storage, and utilization (CCUS) in achieving emissions reductions. For instance, in the energy industry’s low-carbon scenario, approximately 1 Mt of carbon is projected to be recovered by 2050. The forest industry’s scenario estimates that up to 6 Mt of biogenic carbon could be captured annually by 2040, with 5 MtCO2/a utilized as industrial raw material. The chemical industry’s low-carbon scenario anticipates recovering 0.5 MtCO2 annually after 2030, with biogenic carbon accounting for 0.2 MtCO2.
Some roadmaps propose legislative changes to support the market entry of new CCU products. For example, the energy industry’s roadmap suggests that CO2 from sustainable bioenergy and waste should be accepted as a raw material for the production of synthetic fuels. Investment subsidies, tax breaks, and incentives should also be used to promote CCS&U. The forest industry’s roadmap calls for an incentive system for both demonstration and pilot plants, and later for commercial plants. The roadmaps highlight the need for smooth project approvals, and the bioenergy industry’s roadmap points to the potential importance of bilateral agreements in facilitating the storage of captured CO2, as Finland lacks suitable geological formations for CO2 storage.
关键词: 低碳路线图、CCS、CCU、CCUS
关键词(英文): Low-Carbon Roadmaps、CCS、CCU、CCUS

名称(中英文): Voluntary Carbon  Markets Joint Policy  Statement and Principles/关于自愿碳市场联合政策声明和原则
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存,集群
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 美国联邦政府发布了《高质量自愿碳市场的原则》，表明其支持推进碳市场，包括支持CCUS技术的市场。政策声明强调了高质量碳市场在支持脱碳努力和加速气候行动方面的重要性。它概述了旨在确保自愿碳市场的可信度、透明度和有效性的原则，这些原则可以在激励私人资本流向碳项目（包括CCUS项目）方面发挥关键作用

The policy statement emphasizes the importance of high-integrity carbon markets in supporting decarbonization efforts and accelerating climate action. It outlines principles that aim to ensure the credibility, transparency, and effectiveness of voluntary carbon markets, which can play a critical role in incentivizing private capital to flow toward carbon projects, including CCUS initiatives.
关键词: 碳交易、碳市场、资本支持

CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存,集群

名称(中英文): New Source Performance Standards for Greenhouse Gas Emissions From New, Modified, and Reconstructed Fossil Fuel-Fired Electric Generating Units; Emission Guidelines for Greenhouse Gas Emissions From Existing Fossil Fuel-Fired Electric Generating Units; and Repeal of the Affordable Clean Energy Rule/关于新建、改造和改造的化石燃料发电机组温室气体排放的新源性能标准；现有化石燃料发电机组温室气体排放指引以及废除《平价清洁能源规则》
CCUS环节: 捕集
工具类型: 财政激励（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 美国环境保护署（EPA）根据《清洁空气法》第111条，最终确定了多项行动，以解决化石燃料发电厂的温室气体（GHG）排放问题。这些法规要求采用一系列温室气体减排措施，包括碳捕获与封存（CCS）技术，适用于新旧排放源。对于新建的化石燃料燃烧涡轮机，法规设定了性能标准，要求从2032年开始实施CCS。对于预期寿命最长的现有燃煤蒸汽发电机组，要求在2032年1月1日前实施CCS。法规还为州计划提供了灵活性，并简化了规则的其他方面。最终规则是拜登总统到2035年消除电力部门温室气体排放目标的关键组成部分，预计到2047年，该规则将使整个系统避免高达13.8亿公吨的二氧化碳排放
主要内容(原文): The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has finalized multiple actions under Section 111 of the Clean Air Act (CAA) to address greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from fossil fuel-fired power plants. The regulations require the adoption of a range of GHG reduction measures, including carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) technologies, for both new and existing sources. For new fossil fuel-fired combustion turbines, the regulations set performance standards that will require the implementation of CCS beginning in 2032. For existing coal-fired steam generating units with the longest expected lifespan, CCS is required to be implemented by January 1, 2032. The regulations also provide flexibility for state plans and streamline other aspects of the rule. The Final Rule is a key element of President Biden’s goal to eliminate GHG emissions from the power sector by 2035 and is expected to result in the avoidance of up to 1.38 billion metric tons of CO2 emissions systemwide through 2047
关键词: 碳排放、法规标准、碳捕集
关键词(英文): Carbon emissions, regulatory standards, carbon capture

名称(中英文): Clean Air Act/清洁空气法案
CCUS环节: 捕集,利用（包括地质利用）

主要内容: 发电厂排放限制：要求新建或改造的发电厂、工厂等大型固定源符合二氧化碳排放标准。可再生燃料推广：通过生物燃料标准降低交通领域对化石燃料的依赖。区域碳市场计划：支持通过交易机制实现总量控制和成本优化
主要内容(原文): Power plant emission limits: Require new or renovated power plants, factories and other large fixed sources to meet carbon dioxide emission standards. Renewable fuel promotion: Reduce dependence on fossil fuels in the transportation sector through biofuel standards. Regional carbon Market programs: Support volume control and cost optimization through trading mechanisms

名称(中英文): Amendments to the Underground Injection Control Act (UIC) rules/《地下注入控制法》（UIC）规则修订
CCUS环节: 封存
工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 根据项目的位置和规模，CCUS项目可能需要各种许可证。例如，在符合或无法分类为国家环境空气质量标准（NAAQS）的地区，新的主要固定污染源或重大改造需要防止重大恶化（PSD）许可证。在不符合NAAQS的地区，需要非达标新源审查（NNSR）许可证。排放低于主要新源审查（NSR）阈值的较小污染源或改造则需要小型新源审查（Minor NSR）许可证。根据《安全饮用水法案》建立的地下注入控制（UIC）计划，监管包括二氧化碳（CO2）在内的地下流体注入，以保护地下饮用水源。CCUS项目属于两个主要的UIC井类别：第二类井，用于与石油和天然气生产相关的液体（二氧化碳的储存通常是此类操作的附带品）；以及第六类井，用于将二氧化碳注入深层地质构造以储存。美国环保署（EPA）已经为第六类井制定了规则，以解决二氧化碳的永久储存、场地特征描述、井的建造、运营、测试、监测和关闭等问题。许多州管理着某些等级的油井UIC计划，北达科他州和怀俄明州被授权管理第六类井。CCUS项目的二氧化碳泄漏可能导致违反适用的《清洁空气法》（CAA）或许可证。白宫环境质量委员会（CEQ）于2022年发布的临时指导旨在澄清和简化CCUS许可，利用FAST-41协调二氧化碳管道扩建的监管和《基础设施投资与就业法案》（IIJA）的实施，促进跨机构合作，并考虑环境正义原则。CCUS项目还可能需要《清洁水法》许可证，海上项目必须遵守《海洋保护、研究和保护区法》（MPRSA）和《外大陆架土地法》（OCSLA）。联邦土地上的项目需要额外的许可证，并且必须遵守《国家环境政策法》（NEPA）和其他相关法律
主要内容(原文): CCUS projects may require various permits depending on their location and scale. For instance, new major stationary sources or significant modifications in areas meeting or unclassifiable under National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) need Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD) permits. In areas not meeting NAAQS, Non-Attainment New Source Review (NNSR) permits are required. Smaller sources or modifications below major NSR thresholds need Minor NSR permits. The UIC program, established under the Safe Drinking Water Act, regulates underground fluid injection, including CO2, to protect underground drinking water sources. CCUS projects fall into two main UIC well categories: Class II wells for liquids related to oil and gas production (with CO2 storage often incidental) and Class VI wells for injecting CO2 into deep geological formations for storage. The EPA has developed Class VI rules addressing CO2 permanent storage, site characterization, well construction, operation, testing, monitoring, and closure. Many states manage UIC programs for certain well classes, with North Dakota and Wyoming authorized for Class VI wells. CO2 leaks from CCUS projects could violate applicable CAA or UIC permits. The CEQ's 2022 interim guidance aims to clarify and streamline CCUS permitting, utilizing FAST-41 to coordinate CO2 pipeline expansion regulations and IIJA implementation, promoting interagency cooperation, and considering environmental justice. CCUS projects may also need Clean Water Act permits, and offshore projects must comply with MPRSA and OCSLA. Federal land projects require additional permits and must adhere to NEPA and other relevant laws
关键词: 碳封存、·碳监测、二氧化碳注入
关键词(英文): Carbon sequestration, carbon monitoring, carbon dioxide injection

名称(中英文): Shaanxi Provincial Carbon Peak Implementation Plan/陕西省碳达峰实施方案
CCUS环节: 运输,捕集,利用（包括地质利用）
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 主要目标：“十四五” 期间产业和能源结构优化，绿色生产生活方式推行；到 2025 年非化石能源消费比重达 16% 左右。“十五五” 期间产业结构重大调整，能源体系初步建立；到 2030 年非化石能源消费比重达 20% 左右，实现碳达峰。主要任务：能源体系：推进化石能源清洁高效利用，发展非化石能源，建设多元储能系统和新型电力系统。节能降碳：落实节约优先方针，实施重点工程，加强重点用能单位和设备管理。工业转型：优化产业结构，推动煤化工、石油化工等行业绿色低碳发展，遏制 “两高一低” 项目。城乡建设：开展城镇绿色更新，推进建筑和村镇绿色发展。交通运输：优化用能结构，完善网络，配套基础设施。循环经济：推进园区循环，综合利用废弃物，回收再生资源，减量化资源化城乡垃圾。 科技创新：突破关键技术，转化科技成果，培育低碳产业。 生态碳汇：巩固生态固碳，提升碳汇能力，发挥农业作用。社会发展：开展宣传教育，引导公众和企业践行，改造公共机构，转型服务业，强化干部培训。有序达峰：分类推动地区达峰，制定路线图，创建试点，推进园区和企业达峰。国际合作：加强绿色技术、经贸合作，建设交流平台。
主要内容(原文):
“十四五”期间，全省产业结构和能源结构调整优化取得明显进展，重点行业能源利用效率显著提升，新型电力系统加快构建，绿色低碳技术研发和推广应用取得新进展，源头低碳、过程减碳、末端固碳的碳减排体系初步形成，绿色生产生活方式得到普遍推行，有利于绿色低碳循环发展的政策体系进一步完善。到2025年，全省非化石能源消费比重达到16%左右，单位地区生产总值能源消耗和二氧化碳排放下降确保完成国家下达目标，为实现碳达峰奠定坚实基础。

“十五五”期间，全省产业结构调整取得重大进展，清洁低碳安全高效的能源体系初步建立，重点领域低碳发展模式基本形成，重点耗能行业能源利用效率达到国内先进水平，非化石能源消费比重进一步提高，绿色低碳技术和产业化应用取得实质性突破，源头低碳、过程减碳、末端固碳的碳减排体系全面建立，绿色生活方式成为公众自觉选择，绿色低碳循环发展政策体系基本健全。到2030年，非化石能源消费比重达到20%左右，单位地区生产总值能源消耗和二氧化碳排放持续下降，顺利实现2030年前碳达峰目标。
关键词: 节能减排，碳达峰，燃料，可再生能源，绿色转型
关键词(英文): Energy conservation and emission reduction, carbon peaking, fuel, renewable energy, Green transition

名称(中英文): Shaanxi Provincial Energy Budget Management Implementation Plan/陕西省用能预算管理实施方案
行业: 油气行业,电力行业,化工行业,钢铁行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
管理范围：钢铁、有色、建材等工业重点领域行业，年综合能源消费量 5000 吨标准煤及以上重点用能企业（电力行业除外）。
管理原则：考虑企业单位产品能效水平等因素确定用能预算指标，原料用能、可再生能源绿色电力不纳入或不占用指标。

    基准值确定：存量企业依据 2020 年度能源利用状况报告等确定；新增企业依据节能审查批复等确定，5 年后按存量企业核定。
    年度指标确定：企业年度用能预算指标 = 用能预算基准值 ×（单位产品能效水平系数 + 单位工业增加值能耗强度系数），系数有具体确定方法。
    绿电占比要求：2024 年起省级重点用能单位绿电使用占比达 30% 以上，部分行业达 60% 以上。
主要内容(原文): 钢铁（31，指国民经济行业分类和代码，下同）、有色（32）、建材（30）、石化（25）、化工（26）、造纸（22）、纺织（17）等工业重点领域行业，年综合能源消费量5000吨标准煤（全口径）及以上的重点用能企业（电力行业按照电力调度办法执行，不纳入用能预算管理）。

主要内容(原文): The Union should aim to achieve a balance between anthropogenic economy-wide emissions by sources and removals by sinks of greenhouse gases domestically within the Union by 2050 and, as appropriate, achieve negative emissions thereafter. That objective should encompass Union-wide greenhouse gas emissions and removals regulated in Union law. It should be possible to address such emissions and removals in the context of the review of the relevant climate and energy legislation. Sinks include natural and technological solutions, as reported in the Union’s greenhouse gas inventories to the UNFCCC. Solutions that are based on carbon capture and storage (CCS) and carbon capture and use (CCU) technologies can play a role in decarbonisation, especially for the mitigation of process emissions in industry, for the Member States that choose this technology. The Union-wide 2050 climateneutrality objective should be pursued by all Member States collectively, and Member States, the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission should take the necessary measures to enable its achievement. Measures at Union level will constitute an important part of the measures needed to achieve the ojective.

主要内容(原文): Denmark announced a third fund that will support the development of carbon capture and storage (CCS) initiatives in the country as part of its decarbonization strategy. The country announced an astounding $4.2 billion (DKK 28.7 billion) fund, a third of its kind in a series of government-released funding opportunities directed towards the advancement of CCS projects that will help reduce Denmark’s carbon footprint.The latest fund, provided by the Danish Energy Agency, is now in the tendering process, where interested parties can apply and submit offers. The tendering procedure will include negotiations, in which applicants bid a fixed annual amount of carbon along with the price per tonne that they will capture and sequester, where the agency can choose to provide financing to multiple contender.Created to guarantee maximum competition, the fund aims to highlight and support the highest possible carbon reductions at the lowest possible expense, providing subsidies that will be paid per tonne of stored carbon.The selected projects will receive the funding over a period of 15 years, and the means awarded will go towards the capture, transportation, and geological storage of carbon that is biogenic, atmospheric, or comes from fossil-based sources. The subsidies come with the requirement that capture facilities must be commissioned by December 1, 2029, and active capture and storage operations must begin in 2030.

名称(中英文): Ørsted Partners With MT Group For New Carbon Capture Facility In Denmark/ Ørsted 与 MT Group 合作在丹麦建立新的碳捕集设施
CCUS环节: 捕集,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 丹麦领先能源企业Ørsted与工程建筑公司MT Group合作，在丹麦卡伦堡建设新型碳捕集与封存（CCS）设施，预计每年可从Asnæs和Avedøre两家发电厂捕集43万吨二氧化碳。MT Group将负责Kalundborg CO2枢纽的管道系统设计与安装，实现现有生物质电厂与新CCS设施的无缝对接。该项目是Ørsted与丹麦能源署（DEA）20年减排协议的核心内容，捕集的二氧化碳将通过"北方之光"项目运至挪威进行地质封存。作为丹麦"绿沙计划"的重要组成部分，政府已颁发6份碳封存许可，助力2050年净零目标。DEA新设立的26亿美元碳捕集基金将于2024年10月开放申请，2026年4月确定中标方。该CCS设施将推动丹麦实现2030年碳中和目标，预计全国碳捕集规模可达70-1370万吨，标志着北欧国家在可再生能源转型中的领先地位。
主要内容(原文):
Danish energy leader Ørsted has partnered with engineering firm MT Group to construct a novel carbon capture and storage (CCS) facility in Kalundborg, Denmark, projected to capture 430,000 tons of CO₂ annually from Ørsted's Asnæs and Avedøre power plants. MT Group will oversee the pipeline system design and installation at the Kalundborg CO₂ Hub, enabling seamless integration between existing biomass plants and the new CCS infrastructure.
This project forms the cornerstone of Ørsted's 20-year emissions reduction agreement with the Danish Energy Agency (DEA). Captured CO₂ will be transported via the "Northern Lights" project to Norway for geological storage. As a key component of Denmark's "Greensand Initiative," the government has issued six carbon storage licenses to support its 2050 net-zero goal.
The DEA's newly established $2.6 billion carbon capture fund will open for applications in October 2024, with winning bids announced in April 2026. This CCS facility will accelerate Denmark's 2030 carbon neutrality target, with national CO₂ capture capacity projected to reach 7-13.7 million tons, cementing Nordic leadership in renewable energy transition.

主要内容: 全球海上风电巨头Ørsted正在哥本哈根Avedøre热电厂建设其首个碳捕集工厂，标志着生物质能耦合CCS技术的重大突破。该100MW秸秆发电机组将作为"丹麦绿色燃料"Power-to-X计划的核心设施，最终实现1.3GW总装机容量和年减排85万吨CO₂的目标。项目分两阶段推进：第一阶段生产重卡用氢能，第二阶段通过碳捕集制取航运/航空用e-甲醇和e-煤油。被捕集的CO₂将直接用于可持续燃料生产，Ørsted同时评估其他生物质电厂的碳捕集潜力。该项目不仅将推动丹麦发电行业深度脱碳，更通过出口低碳燃料助力欧洲交通领域减排，彰显了北欧国家在碳中和技术创新和绿色燃料供应链建设的领先地位。
主要内容(原文):
Global offshore wind leader Ørsted is constructing its first carbon capture facility at the Avedøre power station in Copenhagen, marking a major breakthrough in biomass energy coupled with CCS technology. The 100MW straw-fired unit will serve as the core facility of Denmark's Green Fuels Power-to-X initiative, ultimately achieving 1.3GW total capacity and an annual CO₂ reduction target of 850,000 tons.
The project will be implemented in two phases: Phase One focuses on hydrogen production for heavy-duty trucks, while Phase Two will utilize captured carbon to produce e-methanol and e-kerosene for shipping and aviation. The captured CO₂ will directly support sustainable fuel production, with Ørsted simultaneously evaluating carbon capture potential at other biomass plants.
This project not only drives deep decarbonization of Denmark's power sector but also supports Europe's transportation emissions reduction through low-carbon fuel exports, demonstrating Nordic leadership in carbon-neutral innovation and green fuel supply chain development.

主要内容(原文): Extend the eligibility period for the 45Q Tax Credit by five years - projects that begin construction before the end of 2030 will be eligible for the tax credit. Create direct payment options for 45Q and 48A tax credits; The direct payment option allows developers to treat tax credits as overpaid taxes in order to claim the credit on the company's tax filing. Increase the value of the 45Q tax credit for direct air capture of carbon dioxide - from $50 to $120 per metric ton for facilities that store captured carbon dioxide in brine formations; From $35 to $75 per metric ton for facilities that store carbon dioxide through enhanced oil recovery. Allow existing power and industrial carbon capture facilities to use the 48A investment tax credit in combination with the 45Q tax credit to fund CCUS retrofit projects

主要内容:
主要目标为：到2015年，全面落实国家温室气体排放控制目标，单位工业增加值二氧化碳排放量比2010年下降21%以上，钢铁、有色金属、石化、化工、建材、机械、轻工、纺织、电子信息等重点行业单位工业增加值二氧化碳排放量分别比2010 年下降18%、18%、18%、17%、18%、22%、20%、20%、18%以上。工业过程二氧化碳等温室气体排放得到有效控制。产业结构进一步优化，推广一批具有重大减排潜力的低碳技术和产品。重点用能企业温室气体排放计量监测体系基本建立，工业应对气候变化的体制机制与政策进一步完善。到2020年，单位工业增加值二氧化碳排放量比2005年下降50%左右，基本形成以低碳排放为特征的工业体系。
以实施六大重点工程为抓手，其中工业碳捕集、利用与封存示范工程：在化工、水泥、钢铁等行业中实施碳捕集、利用与封存一体化示范工程，加快推进拥有自主知识产权的碳捕集与封存技术的示范应用，研发二氧化碳资源化利用的技术和方法，探索适合我国国情的碳捕集、利用与封存技术路线图，不断加强工业碳捕集、利用与封存能力建设。
主要内容(原文):
The main objectives are as follows: By 2015, the national greenhouse gas emission control targets will be fully implemented. The carbon dioxide emissions per unit of industrial added value will be reduced by more than 21% compared with 2010. The carbon dioxide emissions per unit of industrial added value in key industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, chemicals, building materials, machinery, light industry, textiles, and electronic information will be reduced by more than 18%, 18%, 18%, 17%, 18%, 22%, 20%, 20%, and 18% respectively compared with 2010. Greenhouse gas emissions such as carbon dioxide in the industrial process will be effectively controlled. The industrial structure will be further optimized, and a number of low-carbon technologies and products with great emission reduction potential will be promoted. A basic measurement and monitoring system for greenhouse gas emissions of key energy-consuming enterprises will be established, and the institutional mechanisms and policies for the industry to address climate change will be further improved. By 2020, the carbon dioxide emissions per unit of industrial added value will be reduced by about 50% compared with 2005, and an industrial system characterized by low carbon emissions will be basically formed.
Taking the implementation of six key projects as the starting point, among which the industrial carbon capture, utilization and storage demonstration project: Implement integrated carbon capture, utilization and storage demonstration projects in industries such as chemicals, cement, and steel. Accelerate the demonstration and application of carbon capture and storage technologies with independent intellectual property rights, research and develop technologies and methods for the resource utilization of carbon dioxide, explore a carbon capture, utilization and storage technology roadmap suitable for China's national conditions, and continuously strengthen the capacity building of industrial carbon capture, utilization and storage.

名称(中英文): Industrial Green Development Plan (2016-2020)/工业绿色发展规划（2016-2020年）
CCUS环节: 利用（包括地质利用）,捕集,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
目标到2020年，绿色发展理念成为工业全领域全过程的普遍要求，工业绿色发展推进机制基本形成，绿色制造产业成为经济增长新引擎和国际竞争新优势，工业绿色发展整体水平显著提升。
能源利用效率显著提升。工业能源消耗增速减缓，六大高耗能行业占工业增加值比重继续下降，部分重化工业能源消耗出现拐点，主要行业单位产品能耗达到或接近世界先进水平，部分工业行业碳排放量接近峰值，绿色低碳能源占工业能源消费量的比重明显提高。资源利用水平明显提高。单位工业增加值用水量进一步下降，大宗工业固体废物综合利用率进一步提高，主要再生资源回收利用率稳步上升。清洁生产水平大幅提升。先进适用清洁生产技术工艺及装备基本普及，钢铁、水泥、造纸等重点行业清洁生产水平显著提高，工业二氧化硫、氮氧化物、化学需氧量和氨氮排放量明显下降，高风险污染物排放大幅削减。绿色制造产业快速发展。绿色产品大幅增长，电动汽车及太阳能、风电等新能源技术装备制造水平显著提升，节能环保装备、产品与服务等绿色产业形成新的经济增长点。绿色制造体系初步建立。绿色制造标准体系基本建立，绿色设计与评价得到广泛应用，建立百家绿色示范园区和千家绿色示范工厂，推广普及万种绿色产品，主要产业初步形成绿色供应链。
在削减温室气体排放，积极促进低碳转型上，鼓励建材、化工等行业实施碳捕集、利用与封存试点示范，促进二氧化碳资源化利用。
主要内容(原文):
By 2020, the concept of green development will become a common requirement throughout the entire industrial field and the whole process. A basic mechanism for promoting industrial green development will be formed. The green manufacturing industry will become a new engine for economic growth and a new competitive advantage in international competition, and the overall level of industrial green development will be significantly improved.
The energy utilization efficiency will be significantly enhanced. The growth rate of industrial energy consumption will slow down. The proportion of the six high-energy-consuming industries in industrial added value will continue to decline. There will be an inflection point in the energy consumption of some heavy and chemical industries. The energy consumption per unit of product in the main industries will reach or approach the world's advanced level. The carbon emissions of some industrial sectors will approach their peaks, and the proportion of green and low-carbon energy in industrial energy consumption will increase significantly. The level of resource utilization will be obviously improved. The water consumption per unit of industrial added value will decrease further. The comprehensive utilization rate of bulk industrial solid waste will be further increased, and the recycling rate of major renewable resources will rise steadily. The level of cleaner production will be greatly improved. Advanced and applicable cleaner production technologies, processes and equipment will be basically popularized. The level of cleaner production in key industries such as steel, cement and papermaking will be significantly enhanced. The emissions of sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, chemical oxygen demand and ammonia nitrogen in the industry will decrease obviously, and the emissions of high-risk pollutants will be greatly reduced. The green manufacturing industry will develop rapidly. The production of green products will increase substantially. The manufacturing level of new energy technology equipment such as electric vehicles, solar energy and wind power will be significantly improved. Green industries such as energy conservation and environmental protection equipment, products and services will form new economic growth points. A preliminary green manufacturing system will be established. A basic green manufacturing standard system will be established. Green design and evaluation will be widely applied. A hundred green demonstration parks and a thousand green demonstration factories will be established, and ten thousand kinds of green products will be popularized. A green supply chain will be initially formed in the main industries.
In terms of reducing greenhouse gas emissions and actively promoting low-carbon transformation, industries such as building materials and chemicals are encouraged to implement pilot demonstrations of carbon capture, utilization and storage to promote the resource utilization of carbon dioxide.

名称(中英文): A European Steel and Metals Action Plan/欧洲钢铁和金属行动计划
CCUS环节: 捕集
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
通过推广可再生能源、低碳氢能及余热回收技术，降低能源密集型企业的生产成本。鼓励成员国利用能源税灵活性和电网费用减免政策，缓解电价波动。2025 年底前提案扩展碳边境税（CBAM）覆盖范围至钢铁和铝基下游产品，强化反规避机制，确保公平竞争环境。自 2025 年 4 月起收紧钢铁进口配额，降低关税自由化率，并取消部分产品的配额结转机制。计划 2025 年第三季度提出新贸易措施，取代 2026 年到期的现行保障机制，同时启动铝和铁合金进口保障调查。设定钢铁和铝的回收目标，评估建筑、电子等领域的回收含量要求，并考虑限制废金属出口以保障本土供应。通过煤炭和钢铁研究基金（1.5 亿欧元）、地平线欧洲计划（6 亿欧元）及工业脱碳银行（目标 1000 亿欧元），重点资助低碳技术研发与电气化转型。将钢铁产业视为国防供应链核心，保障 260 万就业岗位，支持技能转型，确保坦克、战斗机等装备的原材料供应安全。
该计划与欧盟《清洁工业协议》《能源行动计划》及《欧洲防务白皮书》深度联动，旨在通过行业转型巩固欧洲在低碳钢铁生产领域的主导地位。短期应对美国关税冲击，长期通过技术升级和政策引导，推动传统高炉向电弧炉、氢基冶金等低碳工艺过渡，计划 2026-2035 年逐步淘汰高排放产能。此举不仅关乎经济竞争力，更涉及欧洲战略自主与能源安全，为其在全球产业链重构中占据主动提供支撑。
主要内容(原文): Affordable Clean Energy: Promoting renewable energy adoption, hydrogen-based metallurgy, and grid modernization to reduce energy costs for energy-intensive industries. Member states are encouraged to leverage tax flexibility and streamline permits for green energy projects.Carbon Leakage Prevention: Expanding the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) to cover downstream steel and aluminum products by 2025, ensuring fair competition and deterring "greenwashing."Industrial Capacity Protection: Tightening steel import safeguards from April 2025 and proposing new trade measures by Q3 2025 to replace expiring quotas, countering global overcapacity and U.S. tariffs. Aluminum and ferroalloy imports will also be reviewed.Circular Economy: Setting recycling targets for steel and aluminum, exploring scrap export controls to secure domestic supplies, and integrating waste management into production.Decarbonization Investment: Mobilizing €1.5 billion via the Coal and Steel Research Fund and €6 billion through Horizon Europe by 2027, alongside a €1-trillion Industrial Decarbonization Bank to finance green technologies like electric arc furnaces.Job Security: Ensuring fair labor transitions and skills training to safeguard 2.6 million jobs, while linking steel production to defense needs under the Rearm Europe Plan.

名称(中英文): General Requirements for Post-Combustion Carbon Dioxide Capture Systems (Draft for Comments)/ 二氧化碳捕集 燃烧后二氧化碳捕集系统通用要求（征求意见稿）
行业: 电力行业,化工行业,钢铁行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）,油气行业

工具类型: 财政激励（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
主要技术内容：
二氧化碳捕集技术：介绍了燃烧后捕集的三种主要技术方法：吸收法、吸附法和膜法。
标准适用范围：适用于火电、化工、石油、钢铁、水泥等行业燃烧后二氧化碳捕集系统的设计、建造和验收。
术语和定义：定义了19个相关术语，包括燃烧后二氧化碳捕集、吸收法、吸附法、膜法等。
分类与组成：将系统分为吸收法、吸附法和膜法三种类型，每种系统由五个基本单元组成：烟气预处理单元、捕集单元、二氧化碳压缩单元、液化单元、仪表与控制单元。
总体要求：规定了捕集系统的接口、性能、排放、安全等要求，包括二氧化碳捕集效率、再生热耗、用电量等性能指标。
各组成单元要求：分别对五个组成单元的技术要求进行了详细规定。
试验验证：对试验目的、内容、验证方法和试验报告进行了规定。

名称(中英文): Green Deal Industrial Plan/绿色协议工业计划
行业: 电力行业,化工行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）,钢铁行业
CCUS环节: 捕集,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
支持项目类型: 单一环节项目,多环节项目
主要内容:
通过《净零工业法案》将碳捕集与封存（CCUS）技术列为欧盟需优先发展的 8 项战略净零技术之一，旨在通过提升本土制造能力减少对外部供应链的依赖。法案提出到 2030 年欧盟实现每年至少5000 万吨二氧化碳注入能力，要求石油和天然气生产商按比例贡献，推动工业领域深度脱碳。通过 “净零战略项目” 认定，CCUS 项目可享受优先审批和融资支持（如创新基金、复苏基金等），加速技术部署。临时危机与过渡框架（TCTF）允许成员国补贴 CCUS 项目，简化审批流程并匹配第三国补贴。
创新基金（400 亿欧元）通过竞争性拍卖支持 CCUS 技术规模化，建立 “监管沙盒” 机制，允许企业测试创新的 CCUS 技术，降低市场准入壁垒。推动欧洲标准制定（如电池回收、氢能储运），提升 CCUS 技术的市场竞争力。计划建立 “净零产业学院”，培养 CCUS 领域专业人才，应对技术转型中的劳动力需求。配套《关键原材料法案》，欧盟通过多元化采购和循环利用，确保 CCUS 技术所需原材料（如稀土）的稳定供应。
通过贸易协议和国际伙伴关系（如与美国、非洲的合作），推动 CCUS 技术标准国际化，提升欧盟在全球价值链中的话语权。
主要内容(原文): The act would provide a simplified regulatory framework for production capacity of products that are key to meet our climate neutrality goals, such as batteries, windmills, heat pumps, solar, electrolysers, carbon capture and storage technologies.Following sector-specific analysis, identify goals for industrial capacity by 2030 where necessary to ensure that strategic dependencies do not put the green transition at risk.The Innovation Fund supports the development and first-of-a-kind deployment of technologies and solutions that decarbonise energy intensive industry, boost renewable energy and energy storage (including batteries and hydrogen) and strengthen net-zero supply chains by supporting the manufacturing of critical components for batteries, wind and solar energy, electrolysers, fuel cells and heat pumps.The Critical Raw Materials Act will aim to provide the EU security of supply, including by strengthening international engagement, facilitating extraction (where relevant), processing and recycling, while ensuring high environmental standards and continuing research and innovation, e.g. to reduce material use and to develop bio-based substitutes

名称(中英文): Sustainable Carbon Cycles /可持续碳循环
行业: 化工行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 可持续土地管理对实现欧盟 2050 年气候中和目标意义重大，碳农业作为一种绿色商业模式，可激励土地管理者采用改良的土地管理实践，增加碳固存，还能带来生物多样性等协同效益，同时有助于实施多项欧盟政策。欧盟将通过公共资金支持（如 CAP、LIFE 等项目）、标准化监测报告和验证方法、提升知识数据管理与咨询服务等方式推动碳农业发展。生物经济可通过替代温室气体密集型材料和化石燃料来助力气候中和。欧盟将研究相关方法，以确认生物基产品的碳存储作用，并通过 Horizon Europe 等项目资助相关研究。欧盟支持发展新兴技术，将二氧化碳作为资源用于生产化学品等，同时推动其地质存储。欧盟制定了相关法律框架，通过 Horizon Europe 等项目资助技术研发，并设定了相关目标，如到 2028 年对工业捕集、运输等的二氧化碳进行报告和核算等。为实现气候中和目标，碳去除需完全融入欧盟气候政策。欧盟将建立以碳去除认证立法提案为核心的监管框架，明确碳去除的定义和标准，确保环境完整性，同时解决认证面临的技术问题，并加强与其他司法管辖区的交流。
主要内容(原文): The EU climate-neutrality objective would require to capture between 300Mt and 500 Mt of carbon dioxide from those sources by 2050. The EU economy will use it for the production of synthetic fuels, plastics, rubbers, chemicals and other materials requiring carbon as a feedstock even when a complete and well-functioning circular economy will minimise the end of life impact of these products.The CO2captured can also be stored either permanently in geological sites or in new long-lasting products to provide up to 200Mt of industrial carbon removals by 2050.” “The Directive on the geological storage of CO2 the so called CCS Directive, establishes a legal framework for the environmentally safe geological storage of CO2 by covering all CO2storage in geological formations in the European Economic Area, and the entire lifetime of storage sites.“The EU has been supporting the development and deployment of CCU and CCS technologies for many years. In the past, Horizon 2020 has supported completing the industrial carbon cycle with funding for research on carbon capture, use and storage and the CCUS Projects Network for knowledge sharing. Horizon Europe has launched calls on the integration of CCUS in industrial hubs and clusters, on decarbonising industry with CCUS, on the cost reduction of CO2capture, carbon negative sustainable biofuel production and direct atmospheric carbon capture and conversion. Future calls of Horizon Europe will coverCO2transport and storage, CCU, DACCS and BECCS.A certification mechanism should first focus on solutions taking place in the Union that remove CO2 from the atmosphere with sufficient guarantes on the storage duration, on measurement quality, the management of risk of reversal or risk of ‘carbon leakage’ inducing GHG emissions elsewhere. Robust monitoring, reporting and verification of carbon removals at the level of individual land holdings (section 2) or through the industrial capture, transport and storage of CO2(section 3) is a necessary prerequisite to ensure their authenticity, as well as to minimise the risk of fraud and errors.”

名称(中英文): 能源技术开发和示范计划/Energy Technology Development and Demonstration Programme
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
能源技术开发和示范计划 （EUDP） 成立于 2007 年，是一项基于赠款的计划，旨在支持新能源技术开发和示范的商业化前项目。
EUDP 的成立是为了确保创新技术项目的实施，以支持实现能源政策目标，包括供应安全、丹麦摆脱化石燃料、全球气候问题和更清洁的环境以及成本效益。典型的 EUDP 项目是行业驱动的，有 3-5 名参与者（项目负责人和合作伙伴），项目持续时间为 3 - 4 年，获得 2 - 1500 万丹麦克朗的资金，EUDP 资金份额为 40 - 60%。自成立以来，EUDP 已帮助资助了近 600 个项目，并在将受资助技术的技术成熟度水平 （TRL） 从平均 4.3（在实验室中验证的技术）提高到平均 7（产品开发的后期阶段）方面有着卓越的记录。
主要内容(原文):
Established in 2007, the Energy Technology Development and Demonstration Programme (EUDP) is a grant-based programme that supports pre-commercial projects in the development and demonstration of new energy technologies.
 EUDP was established to ensure that innovative technology projects are carried out that support the achievement of energy policy objectives of security of supply, Danish independence from fossil fuels, global climate concerns and a cleaner environment, and cost-effectiveness. The typical EUDP project is industry-driven and has 3-5 participants (project leader and partners), a project duration of 3 - 4 years and receives funding of DKK 2 - 15 million with a EUDP funding share of 40 – 60 %. Since its creation, the EUDP has helped funding almost 600 projects and has a remarkable track record of advancing the technological maturity level (TRL) of the funded technologies from an average of 4.3 (technology validated in a lab) to reaching an average of 7 (later stages of product development).
关键词: 能源技术开发和示范计划
关键词(英文): EUDP programme

名称(中英文): EUDP基金（丹麦能源技术开发与示范计划）资助Greensand 项目/EUDP Fund supports the Greensand project
CCUS环节: 封存
工具类型: 标准体系（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 2021年，Greensand 项目从“北海二氧化碳封存”特别池获得了总计 1.97 亿丹麦克朗的历史性大型 EUDP 承诺。在项目期间，大型项目财团已经成熟了在北海封存二氧化碳的可行性，并在丹麦的底土中完成了第一次二氧化碳封存。该项目已成功完成 7 个批次的注入，相当于总计约 4,100 吨的 CO2。随着北海丹麦部分成功封存CO2，为 CO2的捕集和封存铺平了道路，以缓解气候变化并帮助实现碳中和。通过该项目，丹麦在未来的地下二氧化碳捕集、运输和封存市场中发挥了核心作用。
主要内容(原文): Project Greensand modtog i 2021 et historisk stort EUDP-tilsagn på i alt 197 mio. kr. fra særpuljen ”CO2-lagring i Nordsøen”.I projektets løb har det store projektkonsortium modnet gennemførligheden af CO2-lagring i Nordsøen og gennemført den første lagring af CO2 i Danmarks undergrund. Projektet har med succes gennemført en injektion af 7 batches svarende til i alt ca. 4.100 ton CO2. Med den succesfulde lagring af CO2 i den danske del af Nordsøen er vejen banet for, at fangst og lagring af CO2 kan bringes i spil for at afbøde klimaforandringerne og hjælpe til at opnå CO2-neutralitet. Og med projektet har Danmark indtaget en helt central rolle i det fremtidige marked for fangst, transport og lagring af CO2 i undergrunden.
关键词: 循环CO₂注入、枯竭油气田
关键词(英文): cyclic CO₂ injection、depleted oil/gas fields

名称(中英文): EUDP基金（丹麦能源技术开发与示范计划）资助Bifrost项目/EUDP Fund supports the Bifrost project
CCUS环节: 封存
工具类型: 标准体系（国外政策分类）
主要内容: Bifrost 旨在通过利用丹麦北海的现有基础设施，为丹麦的 CCS 提供长期解决方案。利用丹麦地下财团（DUC - 由 TotalEnergies、Noreco 和 Nordsøfonden组成）（枯竭的海上石油和天然气田）和 Ørsted（连接到海岸的管道）拥有的资产，初步成熟了 3 Mtpa 的二氧化碳封存在 Harald 周围。同时，将寻求获得更大的机会，以封储高达 16Mtpa 的货物。为了实现这一目标，在本项目中，提出了首次展示的活动，包括在砂岩和白垩岩储层中重新利用现有井注入和储存 CO2，重新利用碳氢化合物管道进行 CO2 运输，以及替代运输选择。这些活动将由 DUC、Ørsted 和 DTU 在未来两年内开展，除了技术开发外，还将推进监测技术和协议，并增进对与 CCS 相关的社会经济方面的理解。Bifrost 将成为丹麦释放其在北海 CCS 潜力、实现其碳中和目标以及为目前与 O&G 生产相关的劳动力提供就业选择的关键。
主要内容(原文): Bifrost aims at providing a long-term solution for CCS in Denmark by using existing infrastructure in the Danish North Sea. Our concept leverages the assets owned by the Danish Underground Consortium (DUC - consisting of TotalEnergies, Noreco and Nordsøfonden) (depleted offshore O&G fields) and Ørsted (pipelines connecting to shore) to initially mature a 3 Mtpa of CO2 storage around Harald. Simultaneously we will seek to qualify the larger opportunity to store up to 16Mtpa. To achieve this, in this project we propose activities to demonstrate for the first time, the re-use of existing wells for injection and storage of CO2 in both sandstone and chalk reservoirs, the repurposing of hydrocarbon pipelines for CO2 transportation, and alternative shipping options. These activities will be carried out by DUC, Ørsted and DTU, over the next two years, and in addition to the technological development, we will advance monitoring technologies and protocols as well as improved understanding of the socio-economic aspects associated with CCS. Bifrost will be key for Denmark to unlock its CCS potential in the North Sea, meet its carbon neutrality goals and to provide employment alternatives to the work force currently related to O&G production.
关键词: 枯竭海上油气田、碳捕集与封存
关键词(英文): depleted oil/gas fields、CCS

名称(中英文): Renewable Energy Directive  III/可再生能源指令3
行业: 电力行业,钢铁行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）,交通行业
CCUS环节: 利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 通过规则创新与政策协同为其应用构建了系统性框架。指令首次明确允许化石燃料制氢结合碳捕集的 “蓝氢” 及生物能源与碳捕集（BECCS）项目产出纳入 “非生物来源可再生燃料（RFNBO）” 核算体系，但设定严格的技术门槛：蓝氢需满足 2030 年全生命周期碳排放强度较传统制氢降低 23%、2035 年降至 20%，且碳封存效率不得低于 90%，相关项目需通过第三方独立认证；BECCS 的生物质原料需符合可持续性标准，其能源产出可全额计入成员国可再生能源目标。在工业领域，RED III 设定 2030 年工业用氢中 42%、2035 年 60% 来自 RFNBO（含蓝氢）的约束性目标，并要求成员国在区域供热系统中优先整合工业余热与碳储存设施，为 CCUS 规模化应用提供基础设施支撑。为加速项目落地，指令设立 “可再生能源加速区”，对区内 CCUS 项目实施 12 个月简化审批，并将其认定为 “压倒性公共利益” 以限制法律争议。欧盟通过创新基金（2023 年首批注资 15 亿欧元）、复苏与韧性基金等渠道提供资金支持，挪威 “北极光” BECCS 项目、德国 “工业碳捕集网络” 等已获重点资助。
主要内容(原文): Hydrogen produced from fossil fuels with CCUS shall be classified as RFNBO if it achieves a lifecycle GHG emissions reduction of at least 23% by 2030 and 20% by 2035, with CO₂ storage efficiency verified at ≥90%.CCUS projects must undergo third-party verification of capture efficiency, storage safety, and lifecycle emissions to be eligible for RFNBO classification.Biomass combined with carbon capture and storage (BECCS) shall be fully credited as renewable energy, provided the biomass meets RED II sustainability criteria and CO₂ storage efficiency is ≥90%.Biomass used in BECCS shall adhere to RED II sustainability criteria and ensure net CO₂ removal through permanent storage.Member States shall prioritize the use of industrial waste heat in district heating networks, co-located with CCUS infrastructure where feasible.
关键词: 蓝氢;物能源与碳捕集封存;工业深度脱碳;碳捕集，利用与封存
关键词(英文): blue hydrogen;bioenergy with carbon capture and storage (BECCS);industrial deep decarbonization;carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS)

行业: 电力行业,化工行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）

主要内容: 加强煤炭质量管理，加快先进的煤炭优质化加工、燃煤发电技术装备攻关及产业化应用，稳步推进相关产业升级示范，建立政策引导与市场推动相结合的煤炭清洁高效利用推进机制，构建清洁、高效、低碳、安全、可持续的现代煤炭清洁利用体系。主要目标：全国新建燃煤发电机组平均供电煤耗低于300克标准煤/千瓦时；到2017年，全国原煤入选率达到70%以上；现代煤化工产业化示范取得初步成效，燃煤工业锅炉平均运行效率比2013年提高5个百分点。到2020年，原煤入选率达到80%以上；现役燃煤发电机组改造后平均供电煤耗低于310克/千瓦时，电煤占煤炭消费比重提高到60%以上；现代煤化工产业化示范取得阶段性成果，形成更加完整的自主技术和装备体系；燃煤工业锅炉平均运行效率比2013年提高8个百分点；稳步推进煤炭优质化加工、分质分级梯级利用、煤矿废弃物资源化利用等的示范，建设一批煤炭清洁高效利用示范工程项目。
主要内容(原文):
Strengthen the quality management of coal, accelerate the research and development of advanced coal upgrading processing and coal - fired power generation technology and equipment as well as their industrial application. Steadily promote the demonstration of relevant industrial upgrading, establish a promotion mechanism for the clean and efficient utilization of coal that combines policy guidance and market drive, and build a clean, efficient, low - carbon, safe and sustainable modern coal clean - utilization system.
The main goals are as follows: The average power supply coal consumption of newly built coal - fired power generation units nationwide is less than 300 grams of standard coal per kilowatt - hour. By 2017, the national raw coal washing rate reaches over 70%; the industrialization demonstration of modern coal chemical industry achieves initial results, and the average operating efficiency of coal - fired industrial boilers increases by 5 percentage points compared to 2013. By 2020, the raw coal washing rate reaches over 80%; the average power supply coal consumption of existing coal - fired power generation units after transformation is less than 310 grams of standard coal per kilowatt - hour, and the proportion of power - generation coal in coal consumption increases to over 60%. The industrialization demonstration of modern coal chemical industry achieves phased results, forming a more complete independent technology and equipment system. The average operating efficiency of coal - fired industrial boilers increases by 8 percentage points compared to 2013. Steadily promote the demonstration of coal upgrading processing, graded and step - by - step utilization, and resource - based utilization of coal mine waste, and build a number of demonstration projects for the clean and efficient utilization of coal.

主要内容(原文):
Promoting the pilot demonstrations of carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) is a key task in the work of controlling greenhouse gas emissions during the 12th Five-Year Plan period. The work of promoting the pilot demonstrations of CCUS will be carried out from the following aspects:
(1) Carry out relevant pilot demonstration projects in light of the actual situations of various process links of carbon capture and storage.
(2) Launch the construction of CCUS demonstration projects and bases.
(3) Explore and establish relevant policy incentive mechanisms.
(4) Strengthen the strategic research and planning for the development of CCUS.
(5) Promote the formulation of relevant standards and specifications for CCUS.
(6) Strengthen capacity building and international cooperation.

名称(中英文): Notice on the Action Plan for Further Strengthening the Construction of the Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Standard and Metrology System (2024 - 2025) jointly issued by the National Development and Reform Commission, the State Administration for Market Regulation, and the Ministry of Ecology and Environment/国家发展改革委 市场监管总局 生态环境部关于进一步强化碳达峰碳中和标准计量体系建设行动方案（2024—2025年）的通知
行业: 油气行业,电力行业,化工行业,钢铁行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）,交通行业
CCUS环节: 捕集,利用（包括地质利用）,封存,运输
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
按照系统推进、急用先行、开放协同的原则，围绕重点领域研制一批国家标准、采信一批团体标准、突破一批国际标准、启动一批标准化试点。2024年，发布70项碳核算、碳足迹、碳减排、能效能耗、碳捕集利用与封存等国家标准，基本实现重点行业企业碳排放核算标准全覆盖。2025年，面向企业、项目、产品的三位一体碳排放核算和评价标准体系基本形成，重点行业和产品能耗能效技术指标基本达到国际先进水平，建设100家企业和园区碳排放管理标准化试点。

按照统筹发展、需求牵引、创新突破的原则，加强碳计量基础能力建设，完善碳计量体系，提升碳计量服务支撑水平。2025年底前，研制20项计量标准和标准物质，开展25项关键计量技术研究，制定50项“双碳”领域国家计量技术规范，关键领域碳计量技术取得重要突破，重点用能和碳排放单位碳计量能力基本具备，碳排放计量器具配备和相关仪器设备检定校准工作稳步推进。
主要内容(原文):
In accordance with the principles of systematic promotion, prioritizing urgent needs, and open collaboration, a series of measures will be carried out in key areas. This includes developing a batch of national standards, adopting a number of group standards, breaking through a number of international standards, and launching a number of standardization pilot projects. In 2024, 70 national standards in areas such as carbon accounting, carbon footprint, carbon emission reduction, energy efficiency and consumption, and carbon capture, utilization and storage will be released, basically achieving full coverage of carbon emission accounting standards for key industries. In 2025, a three-in-one carbon emission accounting and evaluation standard system for enterprises, projects, and products will be basically established. The energy consumption and efficiency technical indicators of key industries and products will reach the international advanced level, and 100 enterprise and park carbon emission management standardization pilot projects will be built.
According to the principles of coordinated development, demand-driven initiatives, and innovative breakthroughs, efforts will be made to strengthen the basic capabilities of carbon metrology, improve the carbon metrology system, and enhance the service support level of carbon metrology. By the end of 2025, 20 measurement standards and reference materials will be developed, 25 key metrology technology research projects will be carried out, and 50 national metrology technical specifications in the "dual carbon" field will be formulated. Significant breakthroughs will be made in carbon metrology technologies in key areas. Key energy-consuming and carbon-emitting units will basically have carbon metrology capabilities, and the work of equipping carbon emission measuring instruments and calibrating related equipment will be steadily promoted.

名称(中英文): Commission approves €3 billion Swedish State aid scheme to support the roll-out of biogenic carbon dioxide capture and storage / 欧盟委员会批准 30 亿欧元的瑞典国家援助计划，以支持推出生物二氧化碳捕集与封存
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
瑞典向欧盟委员会通报其计划推出一项耗资30亿欧元（合360亿瑞典克朗）的资助计划，旨在支持通过永久性碳捕存技术（CCS）消除生物源二氧化碳排放的项目。该措施力图使CCS技术成为应对气候变化的有效工具，通过提升投资者对CCS技术的信心、降低未来应用成本，进而推动欧盟CCS价值链的发展。
根据该计划，资助将通过竞标方式发放，首轮竞标拟于2024年启动。参与竞标的企业须满足以下条件：(i) 在瑞典境内开展业务并排放生物源二氧化碳；(ii) 实施年捕存能力不低于5万吨生物源二氧化碳的项目。
中标企业将签订为期15年的合约，按实际永久封存的每吨生物源二氧化碳获得补助金。补助金额将根据项目可能产生的收益（如自愿碳清除证书收入）以及同一项目获得的其他公共资金进行动态调整。
该计划将持续至2028年12月31日。通过促成大规模生物源二氧化碳的捕存，该计划将助力瑞典实现"2045年温室气体排放量较1990年水平降低85%"的目标，同时推动瑞典及欧盟达成"2050年气候中和"的愿景。
主要内容(原文):
Sweden notified to the Commission of its plans to adopt a €3 billion (SEK 36 billion) scheme to support projects removing biogenic CO2 emissions through permanent CCS. The measure aims to enable CCS as a viable and effective tool to mitigate climate change. This is expected to increase investor confidence in CCS-technology, reduce costs for its future applications and thereby facilitate the development of a CCS value chain in the EU.
Under the scheme, the aid will be awarded through a competitive bidding process, with the first auction expected in 2024. Auctions will be open to companies that (i) carry out an activity in Sweden, emitting biogenic CO2, and (ii) implement projects with a capacity to capture and store at least 50,000 tonnes of biogenic CO2 per year.
Under 15-year long contracts, beneficiaries will receive a grant per tonne of biogenic CO2 that is permanently stored. The aid received will be adjusted taking into account possible revenues that might stem from the projects (e.g., thanks to voluntary carbon removal certificates), as well as other public support received for the same project. 
The scheme will run until 31 December 2028. By enabling capture and storage of significant amounts of biogenic CO2, the scheme will contribute to Sweden's efforts to reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by 85% by 2045 compared to the 1990 level. It will also help Sweden and the EU to meet the objective of achieving climate neutrality by 2050.
关键词: CCS、CCS价值链、竞标程序、2050年碳中和
关键词(英文): CCS、removing biogenic CO2 emissions、CCS value chain、competitive bidding process

名称(中英文): BILL C-59/C-59法案
行业: 油气行业,电力行业,化工行业,钢铁行业,建筑行业（包括水泥行业）
CCUS环节: 捕集,利用（包括地质利用）,封存,运输
工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 为符合条件的CCUS设备引入可退还的投资税收抵免。直接空气捕集设备可获得 60% 的抵免，传统的碳捕集、运输、储存和利用设备可获得 50% 的抵免，与碳捕集相关的持续运营费用可获得 37.5% 的抵免。这一举措鼓励制造商采用减少碳排放的技术，推动 CCUS 产业发展 。
主要内容(原文):
This measure would implement the Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS) Investment Tax Credit, a new refundable investment tax credit for taxable Canadian corporations that incur eligible CCUS expenses.
The investment tax credit is proposed to be available to CCUS projects, in respect of the cost of purchasing and installing eligible equipment. Eligibility is also proposed to extend to dual use power and/or heat and water use equipment used in a qualified CCUS project.
From 2022 through 2030, the investment tax credit rates would be set at:
60 per cent for investments in equipment to capture CO2 in direct air capture projects;
50 per cent for investments in equipment to capture CO2 in all other CCUS projects; and
37.5 per cent for investments in equipment for transportation, storage and use.
These rates would be reduced by half for the period from 2031 through 2040.
Projects are only eligible to the extent that they permanently store captured CO2 through an eligible use. Eligible CO2 uses include dedicated geological storage and storage of CO2 in concrete, but do not include enhanced oil recovery. 
Dedicated geological storage must be in a jurisdiction deemed to have sufficient environmental laws and enforcement governing the permanent storage of captured CO2 (currently Saskatchewan, Alberta, and British Columbia). Storage in concrete must be validated by a third-party based on an International Organization for Standardization standard.
The CCUS Investment Tax Credit would be available for expenditures incurred on or after January 1, 2022, and would no longer be available after 2040.

关键词(英文): CCUS Investment Tax Credit，Refundable Tax Credit，CCUS，Eligible Expenses，C-59

主要内容:
总体要求：以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，处理好发展和减排等关系，推进 “碳达峰十大行动”，确保如期实现碳达峰。
主要目标：“十四五” 产业和能源结构优化，能耗和碳排放下降；“十五五” 实现碳达峰；“十六五” 形成绿色生产生活模式，非化石能源消费比重提升。
重点任务

    能源转型：建设新能源示范区，发展新能源、氢能，控煤油气消费，建新型电力系统。
    节能增效：提升节能管理，实施节能工程，设备降碳，新基建节能。
    工业达峰：工业绿色发展，推动化工、冶金等行业达峰，遏制 “两高” 项目。
    城乡低碳：城乡低碳转型，新建建筑绿色化，改造既有建筑，优化用能结构，农村用能低碳转型。
    交通转型：推广节能交通工具，构建绿色交通体系，建现代物流体系，完善基础设施。
    循环经济：园区绿色循环，固废综合利用，健全资源循环体系，垃圾减量化资源化。
    生态碳汇：巩固固碳作用，提升碳汇能力，加强基础支撑，农业农村减排固碳。
    科技创新：完善创新机制，培养人才，研发应用先进技术。
    全民行动：宣传教育，推广生活方式，企业履责，强化能力培训。
    梯次达峰：各地确定目标，推进发展，制定方案，开展试点。
主要内容(原文):
“十四五”时期，全区产业结构和能源结构优化取得明显进展，重点行业能源利用效率显著提升，煤炭消费增长得到严格合理控制，绿色低碳循环发展的政策体系进一步完善，绿色低碳技术研发和示范取得新进展，绿色低碳发展水平明显提升。到2025年，新能源发电装机容量超过5000万千瓦、力争达到5500万千瓦，非水可再生能源电力消纳比重提高到28%以上，非化石能源消费比重达到15%左右，单位地区生产总值能源消耗和二氧化碳排放下降确保完成国家下达目标，为实现碳排放达峰奠定坚实基础。
“十五五”时期，产业结构调整取得重大进展，清洁低碳、安全高效的能源体系初步建立，重点领域低碳发展模式基本形成，碳达峰目标顺利实现。到2030年，新能源发电装机容量达到7450万千瓦以上，非水可再生能源电力消纳比重提高到35.2%以上，非化石能源消费比重达到20%左右。
“十六五”时期，可再生能源装机比重持续提升，清洁低碳、安全高效的能源体系更加成熟，广泛形成绿色低碳的生产和生活模式。到2035年，非化石能源消费比重达到30%左右。

主要内容:
突出碳规划引领：“十五五” 起将碳排放指标纳入多类规划，合理确定目标；研究出台相关行动方案，细化 “碳达峰十大行动”，清理不适应规章文件。
    强化地方碳考核：依据国家指标，综合考虑因素分解至市和宁东基地，再细化至县及重点单位；落实国家考核制度，开展生态资源调查；建立区市两级碳排放预算管理制度，分阶段推进编制与管理。
    探索行业碳管控：以多行业领域为重点，划定核算范围开展核算；监测预警重点行业碳排放，条件成熟时纳入考核体系。
    完善企业碳管理：健全重点用能和碳排放单位管理制度，落实相关标准规范；发挥市场机制，融入全国碳排放权交易市场，推动绿证交易。
    开展项目碳评价：修订固定资产投资项目节能审查办法，纳入碳排放评价；完善建设项目环境影响评价制度，将温室气体排放管控纳入，探索制度融合。
    加快产品碳核算：执行重点产品碳足迹核算标准，参与制定地方或团体标准，开展评价技术规范研究；推动多地多方开展核算，探索建地方碳足迹背景数据库；推行产品碳标识认证，逐步实现重点行业产品全覆盖。
    加强碳双控协调：各地各部门按职责推进任务，自治区发展改革委统筹协调，加强宣传教育引导。
主要内容(原文):
一）将碳排放指标纳入规划。从“十五五”开始，将碳排放指标纳入自治区国民经济和社会发展规划纲要及能源、工业、农业农村、城乡建设、交通运输、生态环境保护等行业规划，对重点任务和重大工程进行安排部署。充分考虑资源禀赋、经济发展、能源安全、群众生活等因素，衔接国家下达宁夏的碳排放管控目标任务要求，合理确定我区“十五五”碳排放目标。在“十五五”时期，将碳排放强度降低作为国民经济和社会发展约束性指标，不再将能耗强度作为约束性指标。（自治区发展改革委牵头，工业和信息化厅、生态环境厅、住房城乡建设厅、交通运输厅、农业农村厅、林草局等参与）

（二）制定碳达峰碳中和有关行动方案。研究出台《宁夏回族自治区2024—2025年节能降碳行动实施方案》，推进煤电、煤化工、钢铁、有色、水泥、合成氨、炼油等行业节能降碳专项行动。对标国家层面“十五五”碳达峰碳中和安排部署，研究制定我区碳达峰碳中和有关行动方案。开展“十五五”时期宁夏积极稳妥实现碳达峰路径研究，提出碳达峰时序进度、发展路径、政策举措和重大项目建议。细化落实《宁夏回族自治区碳达峰实施方案》，制定宁夏回族自治区“十五五”碳达峰实施方案或重点任务清单；深化能源绿色低碳转型、节能降碳增效、工业领域、城乡建设、交通运输、循环经济、生态碳汇、绿色低碳科技创新、绿色低碳全民行动、各地梯次有序达峰行动等“碳达峰十大行动”，细化重点领域行业碳排放目标控制的工作举措、重点任务和保障措施，研究制定“十五五”能源、工业、农业农村、交通运输、林业草原、公共机构等领域碳达峰行动方案和科技、标准计量等支撑行动方案或重点任务清单，确保2030年如期实现碳达峰。全面清理现行规章、规范性文件中与碳排放双控要求不相适应的内容。（自治区发展改革委牵头，科技厅、工业和信息化厅、司法厅、生态环境厅、住房城乡建设厅、交通运输厅、农业农村厅、市场监管厅、林草局、机关事务管理局等参与）

名称(中英文): The 14th Five-Year Plan for Financial Support to the Local Economic and Social Development in Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region/宁夏回族自治区金融支持地方经济社会发展“十四五”规划
CCUS环节: 利用（包括地质利用）,运输,捕集
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
主要内容:
基本原则：坚持党的领导、服务实体经济、防范风险、改革开放、法治建设。
发展目标：到 2025 年，实现社会融资规模增量、金融机构资产规模、存贷款余额等增长，机构体系健全，金融保障精准，资本市场高质量发展，金融治理完善。
主要任务

    监管体系：健全政策法规、监管组织、服务协作、科技支撑体系。
    机构体系：引进、支持、做优金融机构，规范地方金融组织。
    市场体系：发展资本市场、保险市场、金融中介服务市场。
    服务体系：支持重大工程和产业，服务中小微和民营企业，助力乡村振兴，促进金融科技融合，发展绿色金融。
    安全治理：深化治理机制，加强法治建设，监测防控风险，打击非法金融活动。
主要内容(原文):
围绕推动黄河流域生态保护和高质量发展先行区建设，大力发展科技金融、绿色金融、普惠金融，深入实施地方金融监管与发展“3682”计划，提升区域金融治理水平，有效防范化解金融风险，增强金融服务实体经济的能力，实现金融要素配置更加高效、产融结合更加紧密、结构更加优化、循环更加畅通，努力实现以下主要目标。

——金融实力更加强劲。2025年全区社会融资规模增量达到1100亿元，增长26.1%。金融机构总资产规模增长30%以上，金融业增加值占地区生产总值比重保持在8%左右。全区金融机构人民币各项存款余额和贷款余额“双突破”万亿元大关，分别达到10000亿元和11000亿元，年均增速不低于地区生产总值年均增速；保费收入达到270亿元以上，年均增长5.0%。

——机构体系更加健全。持续争取金融牌照、引进和组建金融机构，优化银行、保险、证券、担保等金融机构和金融组织布局，构建治理完善、运行稳健、服务高效和竞争有序、差异化发展的现代金融组织体系。

——金融保障更加精准有力。健全完善金融有效支持实体经济的体制机制，加快从主要依靠间接融资向多元化融资方式转变，企业综合融资成本稳中有降。持续加大金融支持重点领域力度，提升科技型企业、制造业、普惠小微企业和绿色企业等贷款占比，扩大民营经济和涉农贷款规模，提高金融服务的覆盖率、可得性和满意度。充分发挥宁夏企业融资服务平台作用，完善线上、线下融资撮合功能，提升金融工具综合运用能力。

——资本市场发展更加高质量。实施资本市场直接融资工程，通过资金奖励、政策支持和服务保障，高质量推动企业上市和并购重组。新增上市公司5家—10家，新增新三板创新层挂牌公司2家—3家，四板挂牌展示企业突破1800家，私募投资基金规范发展壮大，非金融企业债券、股票融资占社会融资规模的比重稳步提升。

——金融现代治理更加完善。健全党建统领、法治为基、高效协同的区域金融治理体系，区域金融治理能力显著提升。落实国家金融开放政策，加强与“一带一路”沿线国家（地区）的金融合作，持续推动金融高水平对外开放。加强科学审慎监管，推进金融规范创新、持续健康发展。有效防范化解金融风险，加强自治区市县联动、部门协作、政金企协同，推动金融支持地方经济社会发展的政策、法治、人才、营商等体系和环境进一步优化，金融形势基本安全稳定。

名称(中英文): UK ETS / 英国排放交易体系
CCUS环节: 捕集
工具类型: 市场化机制（国外政策分类）
主要内容: 英国排放交易体系（UK ETS）于2021年1月1日取代了英国在欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）中的参与。UK ETS的目标是提高英国碳定价政策的气候雄心，同时保护英国企业的竞争力。UK ETS由英国、苏格兰、威尔士政府和北爱尔兰农业、环境与农村事务部共同管理，依据《温室气体排放交易体系条例2020》建立。UK ETS采用“总量与交易”机制，设定覆盖行业的温室气体排放总量上限，随着时间推移逐步降低，以助力实现英国2050年净零排放目标。每年可创建的配额上限由《温室气体排放交易体系条例2020》第2章设定。
主要内容(原文): The UK Emissions Trading System (UK ETS) replaced the UK’s participation in the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) on 1 January 2021. The UK ETS aims to enhance the climate ambition of the UK’s carbon pricing policy while safeguarding the competitiveness of British businesses. It is jointly managed by the governments of the UK, Scotland, Wales, and the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs in Northern Ireland, established under The Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading System Regulations 2020. The UK ETS operates under a cap-and-trade mechanism, setting a declining cap on greenhouse gas emissions for covered sectors over time to support the UK’s 2050 net-zero emissions target. The annual limit on the number of allowances that can be created is defined in Chapter 2 of The Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading System Regulations 2020.

名称(中英文): The 14th Five-Year Plan for scientific and technological innovation in the energy sector/“十四五” 能源领域科技创新规划
行业: 油气行业,电力行业,化工行业,交通行业
CCUS环节: 捕集,运输,利用（包括地质利用）,封存
工具类型: 立法监管（国外政策分类）
支持项目类型: 单一环节项目,多环节项目,集群项目
主要内容: 作为中国能源绿色低碳转型的核心政策文件，将碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）视为实现 “双碳” 目标的关键支撑，围绕技术研发、示范应用、政策激励和产业协同构建了系统性发展框架：在技术攻关层面，聚焦燃烧后捕集、富氧燃烧、直接空气捕集（DAC）等低成本捕集技术，突破 CO₂地质封存（咸水层 / 枯竭油气藏）的监测预警与风险防控技术，推动 CO₂制甲醇、合成气、可降解塑料等资源化利用技术产业化，目标到 2025 年将捕集成本降至 200 元 / 吨以下，建成千吨级 DAC 示范项目；在示范工程布局上，明确在电力、钢铁、化工、油气等行业建设 10 个以上百万吨级全流程 CCUS 项目，涵盖华能石洞口二厂燃煤电厂捕集（年封存 50 万吨）、齐鲁石化 - 胜利油田驱油封存（年处理 100 万吨）、中国海油南海海上封存（年封存 146 万吨）等标杆项目，同步推进 “风光火储碳” 一体化及跨行业耦合示范，形成煤电、煤化工、海上平台等多场景应用模式；在政策支持体系中，构建 “财政补贴 + 税收优惠 + 市场机制” 组合工具，对 CCUS 项目提供 300 元 / 吨捕集补贴、50 元 / 吨封存补贴，允许通过核证减排量（CCER）参与全国碳市场交易（预计单价 30-100 元 / 吨），实施企业所得税 “三免三减半” 及研发费用加计扣除，设立 2000 亿元碳中和基金及首单 CCUS 绿色债券（10 亿元）强化融资支持；在能力建设方面，制定《CCUS 项目环境风险评估标准》等 30 余项技术规范，建设国家能源 CCUS 研发中心等 15 个国家级平台，推动山东 “鲁北 CCUS 走廊” 等区域性输送管网（年输送能力 500 万吨）和全国封存地质数据库建设，培养 500 名领域领军人才；规划预期到 2025 年实现年封存 CO₂超 3000 万吨，减排贡献占全国 2%-3%，带动产业链投资超 5000 亿元，同时直面捕集成本高（占比 60%）、产业链协同不足等挑战，通过 “规划引领 — 技术突破 — 政策护航” 的中国特色路径，加速 CCUS 从示范阶段向规模化应用过渡，为全球工业领域深度脱碳提供系统性解决方案。
主要内容(原文): 从技术研发、示范推广、政策保障到产业协同进行了全链条部署：在技术攻关层面，聚焦燃烧后捕集、富氧燃烧、直接空气捕集（DAC）等前沿方向，目标到 2025 年将 CO₂捕集成本降至 200 元 / 吨以下，突破咸水层封存监测预警、CO₂制甲醇 / 合成气等资源化利用技术瓶颈，建成千吨级 DAC 示范项目；在示范工程布局上，明确在电力、钢铁、化工、油气等行业建设 10 个以上百万吨级全流程 CCUS 项目，包括华能石洞口二厂燃煤电厂（年封存 50 万吨）、齐鲁石化 - 胜利油田驱油封存（年处理 100 万吨）、中国海油南海海上封存（年封存 146 万吨）等标杆项目，同步推进 “风光火储碳” 一体化及跨行业耦合示范，形成多场景应用模式；在政策支持体系中，构建 “财政补贴 + 税收优惠 + 市场机制” 组合工具，对捕集、封存环节分别提供 300 元 / 吨、50 元 / 吨补贴，允许通过核证减排量（CCER）参与全国碳市场交易（单价 30-100 元 / 吨），实施企业所得税 “三免三减半” 及研发费用加计扣除，设立 2000 亿元碳中和基金及首单 CCUS 绿色债券强化融资支持；在能力建设方面，制定《CCUS 项目环境风险评估标准》等 30 余项技术规范，建设 15 个国家级研发平台，推动山东 “鲁北 CCUS 走廊”（年输送能力 500 万吨）等区域性管网和全国封存地质数据库建设，培养 500 名领域领军人才；规划预期到 2025 年实现年封存 CO₂超 3000 万吨，减排贡献占全国 2%-3%，带动产业链投资超 5000 亿元，同时直面捕集成本高（占比 60%）、产业链协同不足等挑战，通过 “规划引领 — 技术突破 — 政策护航” 的系统化路径，加速 CCUS 从示范阶段向规模化应用过渡，为全球工业深度脱碳提供中国方案。
